Obstetrics & Gynaecology

Dr. Vaibhavi Birle

Founder & Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist

MBBS, MS Obstetrics & Gynaecology

Areas of Expertise

High-risk obstetrics, normal and painless delivery, PCOD and PCOS management, infertility treatment, laparoscopic gynaecological surgery, and complete antenatal and postnatal care: all under one roof.

  • MBBS: Medical graduation (details to be updated)
  • MS Obstetrics & Gynaecology: Postgraduate specialisation in obstetrics and gynaecology
  • 8+ years of clinical training in high-risk obstetrics, minimally invasive surgery, and infertility management
  • Founder & Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, Vaibhavi Hospital, Taloja Phase 2, Navi Mumbai (2026 – Present)
  • 8+ years of clinical experience in obstetrics, gynaecology, and laparoscopic surgery
  • Handles high-risk pregnancies, PCOD and PCOS cases, infertility workup and treatment, and complex laparoscopic procedures
  • Founder of The Vaibhavi Standard: a hospital-wide commitment to full explanation and patient understanding at every consultation
  • Government Recognised MTP & TL Centre: Vaibhavi Hospital operates under government authorisation for medical termination of pregnancy and tubectomy ligation
Vaibhavi Hospital

Vaibhavi Hospital is a women's and maternity hospital in Taloja Phase 2, Navi Mumbai, led by lady gynecologist Dr. Vaibhavi Birle. Delivery, NICU, ICU, surgery and diagnostics, all in one building behind Pendhar Metro Station.
